page.title: Co-pilot
page.subtitle: Ask your data anything. The SQL stays visible under every result so the answer is auditable.

mode.guidedDescription: Shows the validated query and rows, then adds a concise AI-generated explanation.
mode.verifiedDescription: Shows only the validated SQL, row count, table, and deterministic chart. No generated interpretation is requested or displayed.
mode.verifiedCaveat: A valid query and its rows are evidence, but they do not automatically prove that a business conclusion is correct.
mode.adminHint: Choose the response style for everyone in this business. The change is audited.
mode.managedHint: An administrator sets this response style for the whole business.
mode.loadingDescription: Confirming the response contract configured for this business.
mode.updateError: We could not update the response mode.
mode.resultVerified: Verified-results response: no generated narrative was added.
